text: BetterNotes. Rich notes for ideas, plans, and everyday details. Ready offline.
Paper and Graphite keeps things clear: collections on the left, tools above, and space to write.
Open a note. Shape your thoughts with headings, checklists, links, and rich formatting. Your work saves locally.
Keep the context, too. Add pictures beside your words, or sketch an idea with built-in drawing.
Find it again with search, tags, and favorites. Less hunting means more time for the next step.
Write, save locally, and keep working. Optional cloud sync connects your configured account.
Set reminders. Preview text cleanup before applying it. Revisit earlier versions.
Templates, backups, PDF exports, Markdown, Sticky Notes import, and accessible controls.
BetterNotes. Make room for your next idea.
